pre_condition: record is a TracedOpenCodeProcess whose proc field is a running subprocess.Popen instance; timeout_seconds is a positive integer.
post_condition: Blocks until the process in record.proc completes. If the process exits within timeout_seconds, returns the process's exit code. If the process does not exit within timeout_seconds, the process is terminated (and force-killed if termination does not complete within a grace period), returns a non-zero exit code, and stores a timeout error message on record.error. On normal (non-timeout) completion, record.error is set to the error string if one is produced by the wait; otherwise record.error retains its prior value if it was already non-None.
